premises.text: Online connections can be leveraged to resolve complaints with local service providers
premises.evidence_span: Our app takes a resource that all of us have, which is our online connections, our online clout, our word-of-mouth power, and puts it in the palm of our hands so that we can use it to get our complaints resolved on the spot with local service providers.

premises.text: The app provides a way to quantify online influence through a reach and influence number
premises.evidence_span: It summarizes all of it in a reach and influence number, and we calculate that like this. Reach is your friends and followers on Twitter and Facebook. Influence is those you can influence through your friends and followers on Twitter and Facebook.

premises.text: The app is location-aware and partners with Google to provide business information
premises.evidence_span: It's location-aware. We partner with Google, so there's millions of businesses in the U.S. and internationally that this works with.

premises.text: Users can escalate unresolved complaints through the app to their social networks
premises.evidence_span: If we can't resolve it, I'm going to be forced to start a Gripe, and it's going to go to those same people.

premises.text: Businesses are notified of public complaints and have the opportunity to resolve them
premises.evidence_span: we go back to the merchants, and we send them an email saying, hey, this is a Gripe, a public complaint that's been started.

premises.text: Resolving complaints can turn dissatisfied customers into positive advocates
premises.evidence_span: you take someone who's a net detractor or a complainer, and you're turning him into someone who is positive because when the customer marks the Gripe as resolved, the top of this screen becomes green.

value.text: Complaints can be resolved effectively through social influence and local engagement
value.evidence_span: the idea is to take every Gripe and have it be resolved.

notes: Background information and personal anecdotes excluded as they do not contribute to premises.
